name: ClinicalBench
description: An end-to-end multi-departmental clinical diagnostic evaluation benchmark based on real cases covering 24 departments and 150 diseases, designed to evaluate medical agents and LLMs in clinical diagnostic tasks.
reputation: A recent clinical diagnosis benchmark that is promising for medical-agent evaluation, but it is still emerging rather than a long-established community standard.
notes: Addresses limitations of existing clinical benchmarks including data leakage and lack of multi-department coverage; includes four novel clinical metrics; supports evaluation of end-to-end real clinical scenarios.
